title: Facility
description: A physical place operated by government: a city hall, chamber, courthouse, depot, library. A Facility is a Place and nothing else - it is neither the territory (Jurisdiction) nor the body (GovernmentOrganization). The occupying organization points here with schema:location. Meetings point here with schema:location too, which is why this belongs in _core rather than in the meetings profile.

@type.description: Types listed here are cleanly Place-only. Avoid GovernmentOffice, PoliceStation, FireStation, and Library: each is dual-typed as Organization AND Place through LocalBusiness, which collapses the distinction this profile depends on. Use GovernmentBuilding for those buildings instead.

containedInPlace.description: The Jurisdiction this facility sits in. Lets a facility be located without duplicating the territorial hierarchy.

openingHoursSpecification.description: schema.org OpeningHoursSpecification. Note that schema:publicAccess is a Boolean on Place, not an hours structure - a common mistake.

publicAccess.description: Whether the public may enter. Boolean, per schema.org.

maximumAttendeeCapacity.description: Useful for chambers hosting public meetings.
